title: 第1章 九阳穿越（上）

content_zh:
阳顶天此时身处一个完全陌生的世界，这是一个很深很深的洞，洞穴周围所能够看到的一方全部被寒冰覆盖，整个洞穴晶莹剔透。
而就在几分钟之前，他还在水木大学的女教师宿舍中，和漂亮动人的女友同时也是他的老师李碧君在亲热，然后忽然间他浑身滚烫赤红，紧接着整个身体熊熊燃烧，在无比痛苦中彻底失去了意识。
再次醒来的时候，就已经在这个奇怪的洞穴中了。
阳顶天今年二十岁，大二学生，因为老爹是个金庸迷，所以给取了阳顶天这个霸气的名字。
他长得挺帅，聪明，敏感，善良，小坏。但是却有一个致命的特点，那就是体内火非常旺盛，从小怕热不怕冷，零下十几度都只穿一件单衣，食量超级大却永远吃不胖，身体里面仿佛有一个无底洞一般。
当然，这些都不算什么坏事。而且父母带他看了无数医生，检查了无数次都得出同样的结论，这孩子虽然有点瘦，但非常健康。
八岁那年，一位游走西方的邋遢道士见到了阳顶天，面孔惊色说了一句：“没有想到，竟然真的有传说之中的九阳之躯。”
然后，道士告诉阳顶天，他这九阳之躯身上阳火比别人旺盛了无数倍，一辈子不能结婚谈对象，而且就算这样也很难活过25岁，会被阳火活活烧死。
当时阳顶天全家都觉得这道士是个骗子，他说的话也都没当一回事。
等渐渐长大后，事情不妙了。渐渐发育成熟的阳顶天发现，不管是看到现实中美丽的女人，还是看图片视频，只要念头一起来，体内就有一个凶猛的火焰烧起来，让自己的体温迅速飙升。
而且这种情形愈演愈烈，在阳顶天十八岁那年他第一次谈恋爱和女友亲热，后果是不到一分钟时间，阳顶天高烧42度，直接昏厥过去，吓得她初恋女友一阵阵尖叫，打电话叫救护车才捡回一条小命。
于是，阳顶天才想起那句道士说的话，他是九阳之躯，不能谈对象，也不能结婚。
第一次尝试那个的后果证明，道士说的话或许是真的。
于是在二十岁之前，阳顶天不敢谈女朋友，一直坚守自己的光棍。到了今天，他终于忍不住了。因为他的女友太美丽撩人了，摧毁了阳顶天最后的防线。在他生日的那天晚上，在酒精美人，情感的刺激下，两个人终于突破最后的防线。
结果证明那个猥琐道士的话是对的，拥有九阳之躯的他和女人搞对象真的会自燃，全身燃烧。事实证明阳顶天老爹真有先见之明，给他取了这么个名字。
就在阳顶天被烧得魂飞魄散，失去神识，陷入无穷无尽黑暗的时候。再次醒来之时，却发现自己身处一个完全陌生的环境内，一个四周都是寒冰的深深洞窟。
“这里到底是什么鬼地方啊？”阳顶天身躯微微缩了缩，竟然感觉到一股寒冷，这真是太惊人了，从小到大他都不知道什么是寒冷，现在竟然会觉得冷。
“难道这里是北极冰窟？”阳顶天暗道，这里确实很像北极，因为在东北老家哪怕零下二三十度的时候他都不会觉得冷，那么这里至少有零下五六十度了。
阳顶天从冰地上爬起来，开始探寻这个深深的洞穴。他真的很难理解，为什么自己自燃了竟然还没有死，竟然会来到这个莫名其妙的寒冰洞穴，不过幸好自己是这九阳之躯，否则只怕几分钟后就活活冻死了。
这个洞穴真的很深很深，抬头只能看到一小角落的天空。此时外面应该阳光普照，光线从洞口进入，经过多次的反射，使得洞穴底部有了光亮。

阳顶天目测，这洞穴至少有上千米深，而且洞壁完全是陡峭笔直的，还没有任何工具，所以想要爬上去真的完全是不可能的。
洞穴的底部面积不大，只有一百多平米左右，阳顶天几下就走完了。他拼命地想要找到一个出口，或者暗门机关之类的，但是找了很久之后发现这里每一寸都是寒冰，寒冰背后也什么都没有，根本不是石头泥土，从里到外每一寸都是寒冰。
“天哪？我该怎么出去啊？这个鬼地方连吃的东西都没有，用不了几天就会活活饿死的。”阳顶天颓丧地一屁股坐在冰地上，身上光溜溜的也没有带个手机，不过估计就算有手机也没有信号。

content_en:
Yang Dingtian was now in a completely unfamiliar world. This was a very deep cave. The entire area that could be seen around the cave was covered with ice, and the entire cave was crystal clear.
Just a few minutes ago, he was in the female teachers' dormitory of Shuimu University, making out with his beautiful girlfriend and his teacher Li Bijun. Then suddenly, his whole body was hot and red, and then his whole body was on fire, and he completely lost consciousness in extreme pain.
When I woke up again, I was already in this strange cave.
Yang Dingtian is twenty years old this year and is a sophomore. Because his father is a Jin Yong fan, he gave him the domineering name Yang Dingtian.
He is handsome, smart, sensitive, kind, and a little bad. But there is a fatal characteristic, that is, the fire in the body is very strong. Since childhood, I have been afraid of heat but not cold. I only wear a single piece of clothing when the temperature is more than ten degrees below zero. I eat a lot but never gain weight. It is like there is a bottomless pit in my body.
Of course, these are not bad things. Moreover, his parents took him to see countless doctors and examined him countless times and they all came to the same conclusion. Although the child was a little thin, he was very healthy.
When he was eight years old, a slovenly Taoist priest traveling in the West saw Yang Dingtian and said with a look of shock on his face: "I didn't expect that there really is a body of the legendary Nine Yangs."
Then, the Taoist priest told Yang Dingtian that the Yang Fire in his body of Nine Yangs was countless times stronger than others, and he could not get married and find a partner for the rest of his life, and even so, it would be difficult for him to live beyond the age of 25, and he would be burned alive by the Yang Fire.
At that time, Yang Dingtian's whole family felt that the Taoist priest was a liar, and they didn't take anything he said seriously.
As I grew older, things got worse. As Yang Dingtian gradually matured, he discovered that no matter whether he saw a beautiful woman in real life or watched pictures and videos, as long as he thought about it, a fierce flame would burn in his body, causing his body temperature to soar rapidly.
And this situation got worse and worse. When Yang Dingtian was 18 years old, he fell in love and had sex with his girlfriend for the first time. In less than a minute, Yang Dingtian had a fever of 42 degrees and fainted. It frightened her first girlfriend and screamed, and she called an ambulance to save her life.
Then, Yangding Genius remembered what the Taoist priest said. He was born in the Nine Yangs and could not date or get married.
The consequences of trying that for the first time proved that what the Taoist said might be true.
So before he turned twenty, Yang Dingtian did not dare to talk to a girlfriend and always insisted on being single. Today, he finally couldn't bear it anymore. Because his girlfriend was so beautiful and alluring, she destroyed Yang Dingtian's last line of defense. On the night of his birthday, under the stimulation of alcoholic beauty and emotion, the two finally broke through the last line of defense.
It turned out that the wretched Taoist priest was right. He who has the body of Nine Suns would really spontaneously combust when he had sex with a woman, and his whole body would burn. Facts have proved that Yang Dingtian's father was really foresight in giving him such a name.
Just when Yang Dingtian was burned to the point of losing his consciousness, he fell into endless darkness. When he woke up again, he found himself in a completely unfamiliar environment, a deep cave surrounded by ice.
"What the hell is this place?" Yang Dingtian shrank slightly and felt a chill. This was really amazing. He had never known cold since he was a child, but now he felt cold.
"Could this be an Arctic ice cave?" Yang Dingtian thought to himself. This place is indeed very similar to the North Pole, because he wouldn't feel cold even if it was minus 20 or 30 degrees in his hometown in the Northeast, so it would be at least 50 or 60 degrees below zero here.
Yang Dingtian climbed up from the ice and began to explore this deep cave. It was really hard for him to understand why he was still alive after spontaneous combustion and ended up in this inexplicable ice cave. Fortunately, he was the body of the Nine Suns, otherwiseI was afraid that I would freeze to death in a few minutes.
This cave is really deep, and you can only see a small corner of the sky when you look up. At this time, the sun should be shining outside, and the light enters from the entrance of the cave. After many reflections, the bottom of the cave becomes bright.
Yang Dingtian's visual inspection showed that the cave was at least a thousand meters deep, and the cave walls were completely steep and straight. There were no tools, so it was really impossible to climb up.
The bottom area of ​​the cave is not large, only about 100 square meters, and Yang Dingtian can walk through it in just a few times. He desperately wanted to find an exit, or a secret door or something like that, but after searching for a long time, he found that every inch here was covered with ice, and there was nothing behind the ice. It was not stone or soil at all. Every inch from the inside to the outside was covered with ice.
"Oh my god? How should I get out? There's not even food in this damn place. I'll starve to death in a few days." Yang Dingtian sat dejectedly on the ice. He was naked and didn't bring a mobile phone with him, but even if he had a mobile phone, he probably wouldn't have a signal.
